pages.title: A Small Charm
pages.text: Equip a supported magical ring or amulet in its valid accessory slot.

pages.title: A Small Charm
pages.text: Make an accessory part of your build rather than leaving it in a chest.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the ring or amulet’s Curios slot and read its native effect. Ordinary clothing is not accepted as a ring or amulet.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Open accessory slots from inventory and equip the item in a compatible slot. Carrying a ring in a bag does not activate it. Armor/tool previews and HUD colors help compare properties; Elytra trim display needs its specific addon.
